entities.summary: The Josip Juraj Strossmayer University of Osijek, commonly known as the University of Osijek (UNIOS), is a public university based in Osijek, Croatia. Established in 1975, it is the flagship institution of higher education in Slavonia, and one of the largest and oldest universities in Croatia. University of Osijek is a university in Osijek, established in 1975-05-31. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
